notes:
### 1. Product Overview
Gorgias is an e-commerce-focused customer support and helpdesk platform that unifies customer conversations from multiple channels (email, SMS, voice, social media) into a single centralized inbox.
* **Source:** `https://www.gorgias.com/pricing`
* **Verbatim Quote:** "one inbox for every customer conversation"
* **Source:** `https://developers.gorgias.com/reference/introduction`
* **Verbatim Quote:** "The gorgias api is structured with rest in mind. our api has predictable resource-oriented urls, accepts json-encoded request bodies, returns json-encoded responses, and uses standard http response codes, authentication, and verbs."

### 2. Authentication Methods
Gorgias supports two primary authentication methods depending on the application type:
* **API Keys (HTTP Basic Auth):** Used strictly for private, single-tenant applications. It requires a base64-encoded string of the user's username and API key.
  * **Source:** `https://developers.gorgias.com/docs/access-tokens-api-keys`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "👉 please remember that the api key authentication method can be used only for private apps ."
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "curl --request get \ --url https://your-customer-account.gorgias.com/api/account \ --header 'authorization: basic base64encode(username:api_key)'"
* **OAuth2 Bearer Tokens:** Required for all public, multi-tenant applications. It utilizes standard bearer tokens and granular scopes.
  * **Source:** `https://developers.gorgias.com/docs/oauth2-bearer-token`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "👉 please remember that oauth2 is required for all public apps to be approved."
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "curl --request get \ --url https://your-customer-account.gorgias.com/api/account \ --header 'authorization: bearer your-plain-text-access-token'"

**Primary Auth for Multi-Tenant Integration:** `oauth2` (OAuth2 Bearer Token), as it is explicitly mandated by Gorgias for public integrations.

### 3. Credential Acquisition & Cost
* **How to get credentials:** For private apps, an administrator can instantly generate an API key via the account settings UI. For public multi-tenant apps, developers must register on the developer portal, create a trial account, and submit a draft app form to request a sandbox environment.
  * **Source:** `https://developers.gorgias.com/docs/access-tokens-api-keys`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "1. register on developer portal & get gorgias sandbox account 2. create a draft app submission form 3. set up oauth2 4. build and test your app 5. submit app for review"
  * **Source:** Gorgias Developer Documentation (via Google Search)
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "Once you register, feel free to create a trial account and reach out to [email protected] to transform it into a developer account. ⚠️ You will need to have a draft app to get approved for the Sandbox Account."
* **Cost:** Gorgias provides a 7-day free trial, after which a paid subscription is required (starting at $10/month for the Starter tier).
  * **Source:** `open.cx` (via Google Search)
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "7 days, no payment. Price: Gorgias Starter $10/mo (50 tickets, 3 seats); Basic $60/mo (300 tickets)."
* **Access Tier:** `approval_required` (While anyone can register on the portal, obtaining a functional sandbox account and publishing a public multi-tenant app requires submitting a draft app form and receiving manual approval from the vendor).

### 4. API Technical Details
* **API Style:** REST
  * **Source:** `https://developers.gorgias.com/reference/introduction`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "The gorgias api is structured with rest in mind."
* **Breadth:** High. The API covers accounts, settings, customers, tickets, messages, and custom fields across approximately 108 endpoints.
  * **Source:** `github.com/mattcoatsworth/Gorgias-MCP-Server` (via Google Search)
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "gorgias-pp-mcp runs in code-orchestration mode and exposes a small fixed set of tools that collectively reach all 108 Gorgias endpoints."
* **OpenAPI Spec:** Yes, natively provided.
  * **Source:** `https://developers.gorgias.com/reference/introduction`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "visit https://developers.gorgias.com/llms.txt for an index of all pages formatted in markdown and endpoints in openapi."
* **Webhooks:** Yes, supported via "HTTP integrations" that trigger on events like ticket creation or updates.
  * **Source:** Gorgias Help Center (via Google Search)
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "From your helpdesk, click the Settings icon in the bottom-left corner. In the menu, locate Account, then select HTTP integration. Click the Manage tab, then click Add HTTP integration."
* **Sandbox:** Yes, available but requires manual approval.
  * **Source:** Gorgias Developer Documentation (via Google Search)
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "⚠️ You will need to have a draft app to get approved for the Sandbox Account."

### 5. MCP Server Availability
* **Availability Tier:** `community_only`
* **Details:** No official MCP server is published by Gorgias. Multiple community implementations exist on GitHub and third-party registries.
  * **Source:** `https://github.com/mattcoatsworth/Gorgias-MCP-Server`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "An MCP server for interacting with the Gorgias helpdesk API. This server provides tools and resources for managing tickets, customers, and other Gorgias functionality."
  * **Source:** `https://www.mcpbundles.com/skills/gorgias`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "gorgias tools: 19 customer relation gorgias connect your account, then chat with ai to run tools."

### 6. Buildability Verdict & Main Blocker
* **Verdict:** `ready_with_friction`
* **Main Blocker:** `app_review` (While the API is comprehensive and an OpenAPI spec is available, developers face friction because obtaining a sandbox account requires manual approval via a draft app submission, and deploying a multi-tenant integration requires a formal public app review process).
